attributes.additional_details: Families need help, guidance, and a fair chance to rebuild—not to feel forgotten once decisions have been made. Children deserve stability, but they also deserve a system that recognises the importance of their identity, history, and connections.
attributes.background:
When children are removed from their birth parents, it can often feel like the voices of those parents are pushed aside.
